local_differences: Replaces TBB and unordered_dense with stable serial grouping, std::unordered_map, and std::list LRU.
Builds group starts with zero, every transition, and the N sentinel to retain all points in one-voxel batches.
Checks finite XYZ, matched positive ranges, floor/round casts, 21-bit Morton domain, finite moments, and image allocation bounds.
Bounds image storage by Config.maxImagePixels_ (default 1048576 pixels) and throws on image/numeric failures.
Uses complete Morton keys without aliasing and checked signed neighbor offsets.
Adds GetVoxel, FindVoxel, Size, PointCount, and raw-pixel world Snapshot contracts for the native consumer.
Does not import the author's registration optimizer, Ceres inertial window, or pipeline.
